question: As per 13th Edition of "Handbook on Fisheries Statistics", which state of India is the largest producer of marine fish?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gujarat** is the largest producer of marine fish in India.
 
• This information is based on the 13th Edition of the "Handbook on Fisheries Statistics".
 
• Gujarat's coastline and extensive fishing activities contribute significantly to its leading position in marine fish production.
 
• Other states like Andhra Pradesh and Kerala also have significant marine fish production, but Gujarat tops the list.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The "Handbook on Fisheries Statistics" is published by the Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry, and Dairying, Government of India.
 
• The handbook provides comprehensive data on India's fisheries sector, including marine, inland, and aquaculture fisheries.
 
• Fisheries play a crucial role in India's economy, providing employment and contributing to food security.
 
• Gujarat's dominance in marine fish production is supported by its long coastline, advanced fishing techniques, and robust infrastructure.
